<parameter name="content"># checkout-service

Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma on Postgres. Owned by the payments squad.

## Money

- All amounts are integer cents. Never use floats for money (a 2024 float-rounding incident corrupted invoices).

## Commands

- `npm run test:unit` runs unit tests.
- `npm test` runs the Playwright E2E suite and fails unless a dev server is already running. Start `npm run dev` first.

## Migrations

- Always use `./scripts/migrate.sh`. Never run `prisma migrate` directly; it breaks the shadow database that CI relies on.

## Auth

- API routes authenticate with a custom `X-Session-Token` header, not Bearer tokens. The scheme is documented in `docs/api.md`; read it before touching auth.

## Code style

Follow typical TypeScript style, with two project-specific rules:

- No default exports.
- Zod schemas live next to their route handlers.

The full guide is `docs/style-guide.md` (long; consult only when needed).
